_purpose: Wave-5 (MX-I) knobs.  Identical to waves 1-3's shared knob file, deliberately: Step 1 REPRODUCES sealed MLP cells before it reviews them, and a reproduction that changed a knob would be a different cell wearing the old cell's id.  Every wave-5 cell that is not a reproduction runs at the same registered defaults, so a wave-5 number and a wave-1..3 number differ by their level and their site and by nothing else.
_calibration_tolerance_note: Unchanged from NOTES-MX-D 4 / MX-E / MX-F / MX-G: the evidence base is captured with a bfloat16 parent, so the sealed activation rows carry ~2^-9 relative quantization and the copy_exact calibration arm cannot beat that floor.  Waves 1-3 measured 0.000638-0.002282 across every component that could run the gate.
